decision: D-364 (pre-registration: the float16 one-cell check; the author's D-318 (7) item 5, D-357 (B)(3), (B)(5)); D-361 (2) (the D-156 estimator on Phase 2, split v2); D-320 (4) (the join rule); D-307 (1) (durable caches only); D-117 (the selection of record); D-156
role: storage validation (D-364 (4)): decides whether the LoRA user-span-mean subsets may be stored in float16; not an analysis that enters the paper. The A values are Phase 2 evaluation numbers of one cell, reported only as part of this check

verdict.rule: D-364 (3): float16 storage is ALLOWED only if, for every operating-point number (paired ratio, FPR/target pre and post; frozen split and D-156 mean), |log(B / A)| < 0.008, and for every TPR number (pre, post, delta; frozen and D-156 mean) |B - A| < 0.001; else float16 is not used and every LoRA subset stays float32. Judged on the 1% numbers (1% primary, D-364 (1)); the 5% numbers by the same rule beside, never the verdict (D-361 (4)). Strict inequalities; TPR differences in exact rational arithmetic from the hit counts; a ratio number not finite and positive in both arms fails.
verdict.consequence: ALLOWED: the LoRA user-span-mean subsets may be stored in float16; NOT_ALLOWED: float16 is not used and every LoRA subset stays float32 (D-364 (3))

config.level: item (D-156); the D-164 cluster level is not part of D-364
config.settings_from: the selection record of D-364 (1): arm, layer, C, seeds, holdout (none is a command-line option)
config.draw_seed_note: paired.AXIS_DRAW_SEED holds no Phase 2 axis; this check's draws are shared by both arms and both targets, so A - B does not depend on the seed (D-181, by D-156)
config.estimator: D-156 as D-361 (2): paired.repartition_estimate, unchanged; v2 calibration and v2 eval negatives pooled (calibration first, then eval negatives, each in its v2 file's order), re-partitioned at the v2 sizes; the frozen split as one more draw; the v2 eval positives fixed; per-seed thresholds on the calibration part of the PRE scores; FPR floored at 1/|evaluation part|

arms.B: every scored feature (pre and post; v2 calibration, v2 eval negatives and positives) cast to float16 and back to float32 before scoring

config.probe: per seed, selection_tpr_v2.seed_probes on the stored float32 probe_train (the selection's reporting block), fitted once and used in both arms; anchored bit for bit on the selection record's ho20 TPRs

criterion.rule: D-364 (3): float16 storage is ALLOWED only if, for every operating-point number (paired ratio, FPR/target pre and post; frozen split and D-156 mean), |log(B / A)| < 0.008, and for every TPR number (pre, post, delta; frozen and D-156 mean) |B - A| < 0.001; else float16 is not used and every LoRA subset stays float32. Judged on the 1% numbers (1% primary, D-364 (1)); the 5% numbers by the same rule beside, never the verdict (D-361 (4)). Strict inequalities; TPR differences in exact rational arithmetic from the hit counts; a ratio number not finite and positive in both arms fails.

config.join_rule: A v2 split's caches are its items gathered by item_id from the model's v1 caches, each item from the cache of the split v1 put it in (v1 calibration: the select record's p2wg/calibration cache; v1 eval or pool4d: the rest record's p2wg/eval or p2wg/pool4d cache), whichever v2 split it is now in; plan.items_from_v1_to_v2 counts the moved negatives by v1 and v2 split (positives stay in their v1 split). A cache keyed 'p2wg/<split>' is a v1 cache and is never read as a v2 split. Under D-307 (1) a result reads only ingested caches, so a v2 reader needs the rest caches (or their durable layer subsets) ingested and indexed first.
config.inputs_from: the selection record; both models' select records and durable rest subsets (ingested caches in data/hidden only); the v2 record and its calibration and eval files

durable_inputs: every cache read from data/hidden: a regular file, mode 444, in its record's ingest index with the record's sha256, hashing to it, item for item its frozen split (D-307 (1))

excluded_items.ef72f52bd8c3ec85: D-324 (5)(iii), D-323: its text begins with a literal '<s>[INST] <<SYS>>', which the Mistral and Phi-3 tokenizers read as a BOS id inside the user span (a second BOS for Mistral); excluded before any analysis
excluded_items.52c52cdb43a59029: D-329, D-357 (B)(3): its user text holds a literal '[/INST]', which Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3's tokenizer reads as a control token inside the user span (the extracted v0.3 caches hold it so); excluded from every v2 split before any analysis

v1_keyed_caches.rule: D-320 (4): every cache read is a v1 cache keyed p2wg/<v1 split>, its split file the v1 file the v2 record names; read only through the join rule

pooled_negatives.order: v2 calibration (its file's order), then v2 eval negatives (its file's order)

probes.fitted_on: the stored float32 probe_train (4000 items) at layer 16, in both arms
